name: Jotham
summary: The youngest son of Gideon, the only one to escape when Abimelech killed his brothers. From Mount Gerizim he told a parable of the trees that warned Shechem what its new king would bring.

key_moments.title: Escaped by Hiding
key_moments.description: When Abimelech killed the sons of Gideon on one stone, Jotham, the youngest, hid himself and was left alive.

key_moments.title: Warns Shechem with the Parable of the Trees
key_moments.description: Jotham stood on Mount Gerizim and told how the trees asked the olive, the fig and the vine to be king, and all refused, but the bramble agreed. He warned that fire would come out of Abimelech and Shechem to burn up each other, then fled.

key_moments.title: His Curse Comes True
key_moments.description: God paid back Abimelech for killing his brothers, and the evil of the men of Shechem fell on their own heads. So Jotham's curse came upon them.
